items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
items.blurb: I’ve been self-hosting things for many years. There were times when I was quite enthusiastic about it, constantly trying out new software and tinkering with my infrastructure. But at some point, that enthusiasm faded a bit.

items.title: Mozilla Partners with Mistral to Bring Open-Weight AI Models to Firefox Smart Window
items.blurb: Mozilla has partnered with Mistral AI to offer Mistral Small 4, an open-weight model, in Firefox's Smart Window AI assistant, now in beta. It is recommended for users in France, the US and Canada.

sections.heading: AI coding agents and ML research

items.title: Meta Brings Code Review Auto-Approval More Mainstream with PyTorch GreenLight
items.blurb: PyTorch now lets an AI reviewer approve pull requests from its own maintainers. GreenLight is an open-source take on RADAR, the system Meta uses to auto-land low-risk diffs after safety checks, a risk score and an LLM review.

items.title: Group chat where your AI talks behind your back
